artworks.title: A Member of the de Hondecoeter Family [obverse]
artworks.dimensions:
painted surface: 24.5 x 18.8 cm (9 5/8 x 7 3/8 in.)
overall (panel): 25.6 x 20.1 cm (10 1/16 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Adolph Caspar Miller
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body from the chest up. He is slightly turned to the side with his hands clasped together, holding a folded cloth. The man has a serious expression with prominent cheekbones, a furrowed brow, light facial hair, including a mustache, short brown hair mostly covered by a dark cap, and is dressed in a dark garment with a high, white ruffled collar. A ring is on his left ring finger. The background is muted green.

artworks.title: Crested Coat of Arms [reverse]
artworks.dimensions:
painted surface: 24.5 x 18.8 cm (9 5/8 x 7 3/8 in.)
overall (panel): 25.6 x 20.1 cm (10 1/16 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Adolph Caspar Miller
artworks.description: This is a painting of a heraldic coat of arms with a helmet and swan motif at the top. The painting prominently features a shield with diagonal stripes in black and gold tones. Atop the shield is an ornate silver helmet adorned with decorative golden flourishes. Seated above the helmet is a white swan. A scroll bearing the phrase "TART SVIS VENV" twists behind the swan, while another scroll at the base of the painting reads "DE HONDECOVTRE" along with the date "1543." The rest of the painting features elaborate leaf motifs in golden yellow and dark gray on the black background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.artist: Attributed to Bartholomaeus Bruyn the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Adolph Caspar Miller
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, positioned in a three-quarter view as he looks to his left. He has a fair complexion, a reddish-brown close-cropped beard, and medium brown hair cut at ear length. He wears a black flat cap, a white undershirt, a deep blue or black coat, and a burgundy overcoat draped over his shoulders. He is holding an object in his hands. The background is a muted olive green color.

artworks.title: Lucia Leonard
artworks.dimensions:
overall: 61 x 45.7 cm (24 x 18 in.)
framed: 73.6 x 58.4 x 5.7 cm (29 x 23 x 2 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing the viewer with a neutral expression. The individual has dark curly hair, high-arched eyebrows, large eyes, and a pointed chin. They wear a long-sleeved dress with a high lace collar, a decorative bow with a floral pattern, simple pearl earrings, and a small bead necklace. In the background, there is a green curtain and a pastel-colored landscape with soft clouds and a gentle scene.

artworks.title: Steamer "St. Lawrence"

artworks.title: Clement Bonnell
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing forward with his body slightly angled to the right. He has an expressionless face with a slightly furrowed brow, a pronounced nose, thin lips, and light eyes. His hair is balding on top with some hair around the sides and back. He is dressed in formal attire, including a black coat, a light brown vest, a white shirt with a high collar and a white cravat. He holds a cane or walking stick with his right hand. He is seated near a green surface, possibly a chair or bench. The background features a painted backdrop of a pastoral scene with a wooden bridge over a river and trees in the distance. A red draped curtain runs across the top of the image.

artworks.title: Vermont Lawyer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a wooden desk with a formal posture. He has sharp facial features and light brown hair styled with waves. He wears a black coat, white shirt, black waistcoat, and a black bow tie. On the desk are sealed books, a quill pen in an inkwell, and a folded paper. The man holds a piece of paper in his left hand. Behind him is a bookshelf filled with books and documents, partially covered by a large curtain. An architectural column is visible in the background.

artworks.title: Charles H. Sisson
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing on a dirt path, holding strings attached to a wooden toy with wheels. He is raising his left hand with a stick. The boy has short, neat light brown hair, fair skin, rosy cheeks, and bright eyes. He wears a red and green checkered shirt, gray trousers, and black shoes. In the background, there are white houses with red chimneys, trees, a sky with clouds, and a picket fence.

artworks.title: Mrs. Phebe Houston
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman with the upper torso visible. She is facing forward holding a closed book with her hands together. The woman has fair skin, dark eyes, thin eyebrows, and brown curly hair framing her face. She wears a lace cap and a dark dress with a white lace collar. She has gold earrings with red jewels, and a gold chain with a key or locket. In the background, there is a landscape with trees and water under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Family Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Profile Portrait of a Young Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, in a side profile position facing left. He has a fair complexion with distinct facial features, including a straight nose and a strong jawline. His hair is brown and styled casually. He is wearing a black coat over a white high-collared shirt with ruffles. The background is a solid, muted gray tone.

artworks.title: Profile Portrait of a Young Lady
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile. She is seated with her torso turned slightly to the left. Her facial features include a straight nose, closed lips, and she wears a lace cap with a blue ribbon. Some brown curls peek out from under the cap. She wears a dark dress with short sleeves and a white lace collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is a solid dark circle against a neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Mr. Kline
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image is a profile view portrait of an individual, showing the upper half of the body. The person is positioned sideways, facing left. He has a fair complexion, with a prominent nose and eyes that are directed straight ahead. His hair is brown, slightly tousled, and somewhat curly at the ends. The person is wearing a dark-colored jacket with a high-collared, white shirt beneath it. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background is a muted, monochrome shade.

artworks.title: Jacob (?) Leman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This portrait depicts a man in profile view with his right side facing the viewer. The man has short, brown hair, a slightly receding hairline, a prominent nose, fair skin, and a clean-shaven face. He is wearing a dark coat with metal buttons, a high-collared white shirt, and a black cravat. The background is a simple, dark, oval-shaped area. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects in the painting.

artworks.title: Joseph Leman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a young boy's body, depicted in profile. He is holding a small bird with a red head in his right hand. The boy has short, light blonde hair and features a delicate profile with a slightly upward-tilted nose. He is wearing a dark-colored outfit adorned with small white buttons and a wide white collar with intricate details. The background is a dark oval shape surrounded by a wooden texture.

artworks.title: Miss Leman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a young woman's upper body in profile view. She is standing sideways, facing left with her gaze directed forward. She has a fair complexion, a prominent nose, and curly bangs framing her face. Her hair is styled up, secured with a hairpin. She is wearing a pink dress with short sleeves and a white lace collar. Additionally, she wears a black necklace and gold hoop earrings. The background is deep brown to black, gradually fading towards the edges, highlighting the figure. The canvas shows visible wear and rough textures.

artworks.title: Berks County Almshouse, 1878
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting displays several views of landscapes and buildings, all surrounding a central, oval depiction of one landscape with several buildings. At the bottom is a label that reads "Views of the Buildings & Surroundings of the Berks County Alms House. 1878". The scenes include lush hills, clear skies, and a variety of buildings. In the center is the main complex of the Alms House with red buildings, gardens, fields, roads, carriages, and livestock. Surrounding this central oval is a decorative border with a crest or shield at the top.

artworks.title: The Mounted Acrobats
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting depicts two people balancing on a running horse. The horse is mid-gallop, heading to the left, with a red cloth on its back and a silver halter on its face. It is a rich brown color, with a short mane. Standing on its back is a person with short, curly blond hair and pale skin, wearing a pale-yellow tunic or dress with puffy sleeves, silver embellishments, and white tights. They are standing with one arm extended to the side and the other raised, and one of their legs is slightly bent. On their shoulder stands a much smaller person with the same skin, hair, and pale-yellow costume. This person has one leg extended outward, and they are holding a blue fabric in both hands which twists through the air. The background shows an indoor setting, with teal fabric hung below red drapes, and on the left is the front of a building with peach walls. The floor is gray, and slopes slightly downward on the left and right.

artworks.title: Asa Benjamin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to the right and has an oval face with fair skin. His facial features include evenly spaced eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. He has brown, medium-length hair that is parted in the middle. He is dressed in historical attire, wearing a dark coat over a high-collared white shirt with an intricate ruffled design at the neck. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a warm golden-brown color, encircled by a darker border.

artworks.title: Mrs. Asa Benjamin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper body. She is looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. The woman has fair skin, dark brown hair styled away from her face, blue eyes, and delicate features. She is wearing a soft pink dress with a white shawl draped over her shoulders and a pearl necklace. The background is plain and brown.

artworks.title: Everard Benjamin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a young child's body from the waist up, in a straightforward pose looking slightly to the left of the viewer. The child has a smooth, youthful complexion, full cheeks, and lips, with evenly spaced eyes. The hair is light brown, fine, and falls straight and short. The child wears formal dark blue or black attire with a white, frilled collar. The background is a simple, solid color within an oval shape, with a gradient that lightens towards the center, focusing on the child. The setting has an old-world style, reflecting simplicity and restraint seen in classical portraits.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man (Possibly Peter Vogelsang Sr.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting depicts a man seated in a chair and facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the left. He has light brown skin, short black hair, prominent sideburns, and brown eyes, with his face is in a neutral expression. His left arm rests over the back of the gilded wooden chair he sits in, and his right hand is tucked into his suit jacket. He is dressed in a black coat with large gold buttons running down the front and on the cuffs. Under the coat is a stiff white collar and a black kerchief or tie, as well as a square orange gem set in gold. The background is mostly a gray-green wall, but on the left side there is a thin vertical window showing a view of a green river with a steamboat on it and rocky red cliffs covered in green trees under a cloudy blue sky.

artworks.title: Girl in a Pink Dress
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl standing next to a window. Her eyes are looking directly at the viewer. She has fair skin, dark eyebrows, and dark hair with bangs. She is wearing a pink dress with short sleeves, a white ribbon tied around the waist and sleeves, and lace at the neckline. She is holding a small bouquet of flowers. The background features a red curtain beside the window and a view of a blue sky and greenery outside.
